newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils close quiet as holidays take hol.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils close quiet as holidays take hol.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed quietly as Asian holidays for the Chinese New Year and Eid al-Fitr celebrations took hold, traders said.
Coconut oil attracted most of the afternoon business but even there it was only for very small ammounts, they added.
At the close coconut oil was $2.50 to $7.50 above Tuesday's close. Trade ranged from $780 for Feb/Mar material to $757.50 for Apr/May.
The palm oil sector drifted about lacklusterly all day to finish $2.50 either side of Tuesday's close. The only trade during the afternoon session was for crude palm oil at $577.50 for Feb/Mar.
The soft oils remained tradeless but eased back in line with early moves on the Chicago soybean oils futures. At the end of the day they were 0.25 guilders up to 0.25 guilders down.
